source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 16 (PDF 336-349), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 16 (Lab Safety and Practical Skills (running header: Identifying Hazards and Designing Safe Experiments)) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Why is a chemistry laboratory called a chemist workshop?
(Chemistry laboratory ko chemist ki workshop kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke yahan student ko muqarrar tareeqon (definite procedures) se substances ki physical aur chemical khasusiyat dekhna sikhaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: It is a place where a student is trained to observe the physical and chemical characteristics

blocks.prompt:
2 What should a student do before starting laboratory work?
(Lab ka kaam shuru karne se pehle student ko kya karna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Lab ke naqshe (layout), table aur side shelves ki fittings se waqif ho, aur equipment ya experiment ke mumkina khatraat maloom kare.

book_ref.quote: a student should get himself familiarized with the layout of the laboratory

blocks.prompt:
3 What dress precautions must be observed while working in the lab?
(Lab mein kaam karte waqt libaas ke hawale se kaun si ehtiyaat zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hamesha lab coat aur safety goggles pehnein. Larkiyan kaam se pehle scarf aur baal baandh lein.

book_ref.quote: Girls must tie up their scarves and hair before start working in the lab.

blocks.prompt:
4 Why should students avoid crowding and stay at their own work places in the lab?
(Lab mein bheer kyun na ho aur students apni jagah par kyun rahein?)
blocks.explanation: Bheer se hadsay hote hain. Students apni jagah par aik doosre se mehfooz faasle par rahein.

book_ref.quote: There must not be any crowding in the lab and students should stick to their work places

blocks.prompt:
5 Give two lab rules about food and testing of substances.
(Khaane aur substances ko check karne ke baare mein lab ke do usool batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Lab mein khaane ki cheezein na layein. (ii) Kisi compound ya gas ko kabhi na chakhein, na soonghein.

book_ref.quote: Never taste or smell any compound or a gas.

blocks.text: 16.2 Common types of hazards in a laboratory

blocks.prompt:
6 Name the three categories of laboratory hazards.
(Lab hazards ki teen qismon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Physical hazards, chemical hazards aur biological hazards.

book_ref.quote: Most hazards which we might face while working in the laboratory fall into three categories

blocks.prompt:
7 Why should cut-resistant gloves be worn while handling broken glassware?
(Toote glassware ko uthate waqt cut-resistant gloves kyun pehnne chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Zakhm, kharaash (abrasions) aur jild ke nuqsan se bachne ke liye. Phir toota glassware khaas container mein daala jata hai.

book_ref.quote: to prevent cuts, abrasions and skin damage

blocks.prompt:
8 Differentiate between physical hazards and biological hazards.
(Physical hazards aur biological hazards mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Physical hazards phisalne girne jaise hadsay hain; biological hazards jaandaar zaraye (allergens, infections) se hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The most common physical hazards are slips and falls when working on wet floor.

rows: Sab se aam: geelay farsh par phisalna aur girna.
Sab se aam: allergens, janwaron se insanon mein aane wali infectious bimariyan, viral bimariyan.
Toote glassware se zakhm aur kharaash bhi.
Jaandaar zaraye (janwar, virus) se aate hain.
Ehtiyaat, cut-resistant gloves aur toote sheeshe ke khaas container se bachao.
Allergens aur infections se hifazat chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
9 How can chemical hazards be reduced in a laboratory?
(Lab mein chemical hazards kaise kam kiye ja sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har chemical ko standard tareeqay se, us ke khaas khatraat (pictograms se zahir) aur mehfooz istemal ki ehtiyaat ko samne rakh kar istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: keeping in view the particular hazards and precautions required for the safe use

blocks.prompt:
10 Name three common biological hazards of a laboratory.
(Lab ke teen aam biological hazards ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Allergens (ii) janwaron se insanon mein aane wali infectious bimariyan (iii) viral bimariyan.

book_ref.quote: Figure 16.3: Some biological hazards

blocks.prompt:
11 Why can chemical waste not be thrown into bins or the sewer?
(Chemical waste ko koore daan ya sewer mein kyun nahi phainka ja sakta?)
blocks.explanation: Chemical waste ko Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) ke qawaid ke mutabiq phainkna zaroori hai: munasib label wale containers mein rakh kar muqarrar jagah par treat kiya jata hai, bin ya sewer mein nahi.

book_ref.quote: Most chemical wastes must be disposed of keeping in view the following rules and regulation

blocks.prompt:
12 What information should be written on the label of a chemical waste container?
(Chemical waste container ke label par kya likha jaye?)
blocks.explanation: Waste ki qism, waste ki tareekh aur place of origin (kahan se aaya).

book_ref.quote: Store chemical wastes in proper containers.

blocks.prompt:
13 Name four methods of chemical treatment of wastes.
(Waste ke chemical treatment ke chaar tareeqay likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Neutralization (tadeel), precipitation, ion exchange, aur oxidation ya reduction.

book_ref.quote: where these are appropriately treated to dispose them off

blocks.prompt:
14 What first aid is given for (i) a minor cut and (ii) a serious cut?
(Chhote zakhm aur gehre zakhm ki first aid kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: (i) Chhota zakhm: sheeshe ka tukra nikaal kar cotton se thori methylated spirit ya tincture iodine lagayein (dono disinfectant). (ii) Gehra zakhm: 10 minute dabao dein taa ke khoon ruk jaye, phir doctor ko dikhayein.

book_ref.quote: Every laboratory must have a first aid box.

blocks.prompt:
15 Why are methylated spirit and tincture iodine applied to a minor cut?
(Chhote zakhm par methylated spirit aur tincture iodine kyun lagaye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono disinfectant (jaraseem kush) hain, zakhm ko infection se bachate hain.

book_ref.quote: Both act as disinfectant.

blocks.prompt:
16 Differentiate between the first aid for acid in the eye and alkali in the eye.
(Aankh mein acid aur aankh mein alkali ki first aid mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein pehle paani; phir acid ko kamzor base aur alkali ko kamzor acid se neutralise karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Wash thoroughly with water and then with 1% sodium bicarbonate solution.

rows: Paani se achhi tarah dhoyein.
Paani se dhoyein.
Phir 1% sodium bicarbonate solution se.
Phir 1% boric acid solution se.
Sodium bicarbonate kamzor base hai.
Boric acid kamzor acid hai.

blocks.prompt:
17 What should be done if a foreign particle gets into the eye?
(Aankh mein koi zarra chala jaye to kya karein?)
blocks.explanation: Aankh na malein. Naram rumaal se zarra aahista nikaalein, phir paani se dhoyein.

book_ref.quote: Foreign particle in the eye

blocks.prompt:
18 Differentiate between the first aid for an acid burn and an alkali burn.
(Acid burn aur alkali burn ki first aid mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Acid burn ko kamzor base se, alkali burn ko kamzor acid se neutralise karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Wash freely with ice cold water. Then wash with a saturated solution of sodium bicarbonate and again with water.

rows: Barf jaise thande paani se dhoyein.
Khoob paani se dhoyein.
Phir saturated sodium bicarbonate solution (kamzor base) se.
Phir 1% acetic acid solution (kamzor acid) se.
Dobara paani se dhoyein.
Dobara paani, jild sukha kar burnol lagayein.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Acid burn par bicarbonate (base) aur alkali burn par acetic acid (acid) lagta hai, taa ke aik doosre ko neutralise karein.

blocks.prompt:
19 What is the first aid for (i) a burn by dry heat and (ii) a bromine burn?
(Khushk garmi se jalne aur bromine se jalne ki first aid kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: (i) Khushk garmi (shola, garam cheez): burnol ya mustard oil lagayein. (ii) Bromine burn: 2% ammonia solution se dhoyein, glycerin lagayein; kuch dair baad glycerin saaf kar ke burnol lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Burns with dry heat (flame, hot object)

blocks.prompt:
20 Differentiate between the first aid when an acid is swallowed and when a caustic alkali is swallowed.
(Acid nigalne aur caustic alkali nigalne ki first aid mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein bohat paani; phir acid ke liye base aur alkali ke liye phal ka juice (acid).

book_ref.quote: Caustic alkalies swallowed

rows: Bohat sa paani piyein.
Bohat sa paani piyein.
Ya lime water ya milk of magnesia piyein.
Phir lemon ya orange juice ka gilaas piyein.

blocks.prompt:
21 What first aid is given when (i) a poison or (ii) a salt of a heavy metal is swallowed?
(Zehar ya heavy metal ka namak nigal liya jaye to kya first aid hai?)
blocks.explanation: (i) Zehar: foran thook dein aur baar baar paani se kulli karein. (ii) Heavy metal ka namak: doodh ya anday ki safedi lein.

book_ref.quote: Salt of heavy metals swallowed.

blocks.prompt:
22 Why should water not be thrown on burning spirit or oil? What should be used instead?
(Jalti spirit ya tel par paani kyun na daalein? Is ki jagah kya istemal karein?)
blocks.explanation: Paani aag ko phaila deta hai. Is ki jagah rait aur sodium bicarbonate ka mixture daalein.

book_ref.quote: Do not throw water. It will simply spread the fire.

blocks.prompt:
23 How is a fire in electric parts dealt with?
(Bijli ke parts ki aag kaise bujhayi jaye?)
blocks.explanation: Foran bijli ki supply band karein aur rait daalein. Aisi aag par paani hargiz na daalein.

book_ref.quote: Do not throw water in such cases to extinguish fire.

blocks.prompt:
24 Why does covering a burning beaker of inflammable liquid with a damp cloth put out the fire?
(Jalne wale liquid ke jalte beaker par geela kapra daalne se aag kyun bujh jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Duster ya geela kapra oxygen ki supply band kar deta hai; oxygen ke baghair liquid jalta nahi rehta.

book_ref.quote: This will cut off the supply of oxygen.

blocks.prompt:
25 What should a person do if his clothes catch fire?
(Agar kapron mein aag lag jaye to kya karna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Bhaagein nahi. Kambal ya sookhe cotton kapre mein lipat jayein aur farsh par let jayein.

book_ref.quote: Wrap with blanket or with dry cotton cloth.

blocks.prompt:
26 What is volumetric analysis?
(Volumetric analysis kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Volumetric analysis titration se solutions ki concentration maloom karta hai: na-maloom concentration wala solution aahista aur ehtiyaat se standard solution ke maloom volume se milaya jata hai jab tak rang badal kar reaction ki takmeel na dikhaye.

book_ref.quote: In this technique a solution of unknown concentration is combined slowly and carefully

blocks.prompt:
27 Differentiate between an indicator and the end point.
(Indicator aur end point mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Indicator aik substance hai; end point titration ka aik lamha hai.

book_ref.quote: until a colour change shows the completion of the reaction

rows: Aisa substance jo rang badal kar reaction ki takmeel batata hai.
Woh lamha jab indicator rang badalta hai.
Misal: phenolphthalein.
Misal: HCl-NaOH titration mein pink rang ghaib hona.
Titration se pehle (1-2 qatre) daala jata hai.
Titration ke dauran aata hai; tab burette reading li jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
28 How is phenolphthalein indicator solution prepared, and how much is used?
(Phenolphthalein indicator solution kaise banaya jata hai aur kitna istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1 gram indicator 500 cm³ 50% ethanol mein daala jata hai. Titrate hone wale 10 cm³ solution mein sirf 1-2 qatre.

book_ref.quote: Use only one to two drops in 10 cm³ of the solution to be titrated.

blocks.prompt:
29 Why does the light pink colour of phenolphthalein at the end point fade gradually?
(End point par phenolphthalein ka halka pink rang aahista kyun mitta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hawa ki carbon dioxide aahista solution mein hal ho kar dakhal deti hai; pH kam hota hai aur phenolphthalein pink se colourless ki taraf jata hai.

book_ref.quote: which slowly dissolves in the solution

blocks.prompt:
30 Why is the funnel removed from the burette after filling, and why is a little acid run out into a beaker?
(Burette bharne ke baad funnel kyun hataya jata hai aur thora acid beaker mein kyun nikala jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: HCl bharne ke baad funnel hata diya jata hai. Tap se thora acid beaker mein nikal kar nozzle ka hawa ka bulbula nikala jata hai, phir initial reading note hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Fix the burette on a clamp stand in an upright position.

blocks.prompt:
31 Why is the conical flask swirled during the titration?
(Titration ke dauran conical flask ko ghumaya (swirl) kyun jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acid daalte waqt ghumane se achhi tarah milawat hoti hai aur indicator ka rang theek end point par badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The contents of the flask must be swirled adding of acid for thorough mixing.

blocks.prompt:
32 What are concordant readings?
(Concordant readings kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Woh titration readings jo aik doosre se 0.1 cm³ ke andar milti hon. Durust nateeje ke liye kam az kam teen concordant readings li jati hain.

book_ref.quote: Repeat the titration to get accurate and concordant readings.

blocks.prompt:
33 In the HCl-NaOH titration with phenolphthalein, what colour change marks the end point? Give a reason.
(Phenolphthalein ke saath HCl-NaOH titration mein end point par rang mein kya tabdeeli hoti hai? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Pink se colourless. Flask mein NaOH aur phenolphthalein pink hai; burette ka acid pH kam karta hai aur end point par pink rang bilkul ghaib ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Check that the burette does not leak.

blocks.prompt:
34 The initial burette reading is 0.40 cm³ and the final reading is 13.15 cm³. Find the volume of HCl used.
(Burette ki initial reading 0.40 cm³ aur final reading 13.15 cm³ hai. HCl ka volume nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Volume = final − initial = 13.15 − 0.40 = 12.75 cm³.

book_ref.quote: Volume of HCl solution used = ________ cm³

blocks.prompt:
35 Write the molarity equation used in acid-base titration and explain its symbols.
(Acid-base titration ki molarity equation likhein aur us ke symbols ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: M₁V₁/n₁ (acid) = M₂V₂/n₂ (base). M₁, V₁ = acid ki molarity aur volume; M₂, V₂ = base ki molarity aur volume; n₁, n₂ = balanced equation mein acid aur base ke moles. Is liye M₂ = (M₁V₁/n₁) × (n₂/V₂).

book_ref.quote: Molarity of the given base solution is ____ M.

blocks.prompt:
36 10 cm³ of NaOH solution is neutralised by 8.0 cm³ of 0.25 M HCl. Find the molarity of the NaOH solution.
(10 cm³ NaOH solution 0.25 M HCl ke 8.0 cm³ se neutralise hota hai. NaOH ki molarity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: NaOH + HCl → NaCl + H₂O, is liye n₁ = n₂ = 1. M₂ = M₁V₁/V₂ = 0.25 × 8.0 / 10 = 0.20 M.

book_ref.quote: M₂ = Molarity of base solution

blocks.prompt:
37 How is the carbonate radical identified? Give the equations.
(Carbonate radical kaise pehchana jata hai? Equations dein.)
blocks.explanation: Solid mein dilute HCl daalein: tez jhaag; gas lime water doodhiya karti hai. CO₃²⁻ + 2H⁺ → H₂O + CO₂; Ca(OH)₂ + CO₂ → CaCO₃ (safed ppt) + H₂O.

book_ref.quote: Take about 2 g of solid carbonate sample in a clean test tube

blocks.prompt:
38 Why is the salt solution acidified with dilute HNO₃ before adding AgNO₃ in the halide tests?
(Halide tests mein AgNO₃ se pehle namak ke solution ko dilute HNO₃ se acidic kyun kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dilute nitric acid carbonate ions ko halide ke saath precipitate hone se rokta hai, taa ke precipitate sirf halide ka ho.

book_ref.quote: In the above tests for the detection of halide ions

blocks.prompt:
39 Differentiate between the chloride and iodide tests with acidified AgNO₃.
(Acidified AgNO₃ ke saath chloride aur iodide ke tests mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono silver halide ka precipitate dete hain, magar rang alag hai.

book_ref.quote: Identification of chloride, bromide and iodide radicals

rows: Gaarha safed precipitate.
Chamakdar peela precipitate.
Precipitate aqueous NH₃ mein hal ho jata hai.
NH₃ mein hal hone ka zikr nahi.
Ag⁺ + Cl⁻ → AgCl(s)
Ag⁺ + I⁻ → AgI(s)

blocks.prompt:
40 How is the bromide ion identified? Write the equation.
(Bromide ion kaise pehchana jata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Namak paani mein hal karein, dilute HNO₃ se acidic karein, AgNO₃ daalein: gaarha cream-yellow precipitate Br¹⁻ batata hai. Ag⁺(aq) + Br⁻(aq) → AgBr(s).

book_ref.quote: A thick cream-yellow precipitate is formed.

blocks.prompt:
41 What is the role of aluminium in the test for nitrate ions?
(Nitrate ion ke test mein aluminium ka kya kirdaar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aluminium reducing agent hai: khud oxidise ho kar [Al(OH)₄]¹⁻ banta hai aur NaOH mein NO₃¹⁻ ko ammonia gas mein reduce karta hai. (Koi cell nahi, is liye cathode nahi.)

book_ref.quote: The reduction of NO₃¹⁻ with aluminium metal is a redox reaction

blocks.prompt:
42 How is the gas evolved in the nitrate test identified?
(Nitrate test mein nikalne wali gas kaise pehchani jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh NH₃ hai: test tube ke munh par khaas boo aati hai aur yeh laal litmus ko neela karti hai.

book_ref.quote: This gas turns red litmus paper blue.

blocks.prompt:
43 How is the sulphate radical identified? Write the equation.
(Sulphate radical kaise pehchana jata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Namak paani mein hal karein, dilute HNO₃ se acidic kar ke barium nitrate daalein: BaSO₄ ka bhaari safed precipitate SO₄²⁻ batata hai. SO₄²⁻(aq) + Ba²⁺(aq) → BaSO₄(s).

book_ref.quote: then add 5 cm³ barium nitrate solution

blocks.text: 16.7 Tests for identification of basic radicals

blocks.prompt:
44 How is the Al³⁺ radical identified? Write the equation.
(Al³⁺ radical kaise pehchana jata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: NaOH se safed gelatinous precipitate; thore aqueous ammonia se safed precipitate. Al³⁺ + 3OH¹⁻ → Al(OH)₃(s) (safed ppt).

book_ref.quote: To the second part of the above solution, add a few drops of aqueous ammonia.

blocks.prompt:
45 How is the ammonium radical identified? Write the equation.
(Ammonium radical kaise pehchana jata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Namak ke solution ko NaOH ke saath halka garam karein: khaas boo wali ammonia nikalti hai jo geele laal litmus ko neela karti hai. NH₄¹⁺ + OH¹⁻ → NH₃(g) + H₂O(l).

book_ref.quote: Ammonia gas is evolved with a distinct smell.

blocks.prompt:
46 Differentiate between the reactions of Cr³⁺ and Cu²⁺ ions with NaOH and aqueous ammonia.
(Cr³⁺ aur Cu²⁺ ions ke NaOH aur aqueous ammonia ke saath reactions mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cr³⁺ hare aur Cu²⁺ neele nataij deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Identification of chromium radical

rows: NaOH: Cr(OH)₃ ka hara precipitate, zyada NaOH mein hara solution.
NaOH: Cu(OH)₂ ka halka neela precipitate.
Ammonia: hara precipitate, zyada ammonia mein na-hal.
Ammonia: gehra neela solution.

blocks.prompt:
47 Write the equation for the reaction of Cu²⁺ ions with NaOH solution and name the colour of the product.
(Cu²⁺ ions ke NaOH ke saath reaction ki equation likhein aur product ka rang batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Cu²⁺(aq) + 2OH⁻(aq) → Cu(OH)₂(s). Cu(OH)₂ ka precipitate halka neela hai.

book_ref.quote: Copper(II) ions with a small amount and an excess of ammonia

blocks.prompt:
48 What is observed when NaOH solution is added to FeCl₃ solution? Write the equation.
(FeCl₃ solution mein NaOH daalne par kya nazar aata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Fe(OH)₃ ka orange brown precipitate banta hai, jo Fe³⁺ batata hai. Fe³⁺(aq) + 3OH⁻(aq) → Fe(OH)₃(s).

book_ref.quote: Make two portions of the solution for further tests.

blocks.prompt:
49 How do Zn²⁺ ions behave with aqueous ammonia, first in small amount and then in excess?
(Zn²⁺ ions thore aur phir zyada aqueous ammonia ke saath kaisa rawaiya dikhate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle Zn(OH)₂ ka safed precipitate banta hai, jo zyada ammonia mein hal ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: To second portion of the above solution add aqueous ammonia.
